description: This file is a shell script (diag.sh) used in the OpenWrt Linux distribution to manage system diagnostics LEDs. It detects and sets the status of the diagnostic LED based on system configuration and board information, facilitating hardware diagnostics and indicators.

methods.name: preinit_match_diag_led
methods.description: Detects and sets the diagnostic LED based on board configuration JSON files.

methods.name: match_diag_led
methods.description: Matches configuration for the diagnostic LED and sets the status LED variable.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines and sets the system's diagnostic status LED based on current configuration.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Controls system LED blinking or on states based on the input argument indicating system state.
